intro: A 200ml packet of chocolate milk is about 160 kcal (estimate). Most of it comes from the milk itself and the added sugar for the chocolate flavour.
diet: Yes. Chocolate milk has protein and calcium, so it's not just sweet water. But the added sugar is quite high for one small packet. Better as a snack, for example after exercise, rather than with a heavy meal.
tips: Pick 'reduced sugar' labels at the convenience store.
Have it as your afternoon snack instead of kuih, not on top of kuih.
At home, mix half chocolate milk with half plain milk.

swap.name: Low-fat plain milk 200ml
swap.why: About the same protein, but no added sugar. Saves about 65 kcal per packet.

faq.q: Is chocolate milk good after a workout?
faq.a: Many people drink chocolate milk after exercise because it has both carbs and protein. It's a practical choice, as long as you count it in your daily calories.

faq.q: How much sugar is in a packet of chocolate milk?
faq.a: It depends on the brand, but usually around 15-20g total sugar, including the milk's natural sugar. Check the label on the back.

faq.q: Can I give my kids chocolate milk every day?
faq.a: In moderate amounts, yes, but it's better to alternate with plain milk so they don't get too much sugar.
